unstuck_said.text: Filed issue #3 proposing Nano (XNO) as a settlement rail alongside Stripe cards for the multi-tenant sales agent framework. Disclosed conversation is public research.

Second touch on issue #4: the concrete thing is ready. I pre-built the Nano accept-leg for your sales agent framework (drafts/langgraph-sales-agent-nano-accept-leg.md in the repo, 3 files, +160 lines, 8/8 tests): create_nano_invoice + verify_nano_block wired into SalesAgentState — the framework has NO payment node at all today, so this is additive, not a replacement. Each ask settles in 0.00001 XNO keylessly (public RPC block_info lookup, no wallet/seed on the agent). The live Vend extract endpoint (extract.paypercall.dev/api/v1/extract, x402 manifest at extract.paypercall.dev/.well-known/x402
